description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class PurgeStrategy within the OrangeHRM system, specifically under the Maintenance/PurgeStrategy namespace. The class provides a blueprint for different data purge strategies related to employee data, including properties and methods for managing entity class names, parameters, and interactions with a PurgeService. It encapsulates common functionality for subclasses implementing specific purge logic.

classes.name: PurgeStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a template for specific purge strategies within the OrangeHRM Maintenance module, facilitating data deletion based on employee identifiers and managing associated services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes purge strategy with entity class name and parameters obtained from an InfoArray object.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to perform the actual purge operation for a given employee number.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PurgeService, creating it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Constructs a match array using the employee number and any join parameters for querying.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Fetches entity records from the database matching given criteria via the PurgeService.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters array associated with this purge strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the entity managed by this strategy.

methods.name: getEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the field mapping array for entity attributes.
